families.description: Natural-language goal, budget/max total cost, deadline, quality, seller trust, privacy/security, delivery/pickup, acceptable substitutes and proof/recourse constraints.
Compare sellers/providers and offers; expose live vs stale vs UNKNOWN state.
Buy now vs wait for price/inventory; negotiation, substitution and multi-merchant fulfilment.
Negotiate or substitute while respecting hard constraints.
Existing GroupBuy discovery, eligibility, visible joining and leaving/commitment rules.
Discover compatible demand, recruit willing synthetic buyers, create merchant proposal; merchant accepts/rejects/counters threshold, window and discount. No silent enrollment.
Rent/borrow vs buy: availability, period, deposit, condition, delivery, return and recourse.
Resale/rental/consignment of under-used assets: identify opportunity, show evidence, estimate outcome and require explicit user action before listing/committing.
Proactive opportunities: price drop/timing, warranty/recovery, subscription savings, loyalty, future-demand selling, local pickup, shared logistics and unused inventory value recovery.

Multi-hop TradeCycle with at least three synthetic participants: discover cycle, constrain hops, show each participant's own leg, acquire each authorization, prove completion/recourse; include missing consent, participant exit, invalid cycle and privacy boundary variants.
Merchant lifecycle: create/list product, catalog/variants, price/promotions, inventory, checkout/order, fulfilment, delivery/pickup, returns/exchanges/refunds and customer support.
Supplier/procurement lifecycle: supplier discovery, quotes, purchasing approvals, purchase orders, partial receiving, substitution, stock update only after reconciliation, invoice/receipt evidence.
Autonomous-store runtime: policies, spend/margin floors, supplier/replenishment, promotion limits, stop conditions, approval/handover and audit.
Commerce Twin simulation and what-if/counterfactual planning; prove forecasts never directly mutate canonical state.
Capability/connector discovery and execution through relevant API/SDK, marketplace, browser-only, file/feed, live-commerce, local-edge and protocol surfaces; preserve provider state and UNKNOWN.

Physical/local supermarket operations without RFID: POS/file import, barcode/camera count, weighted item, purchase-order receiving, offline observation replay, conflicting observations and explicit reconciliation.

Commerce trust/security: fake reviews/review rings, counterfeit/wrong item, false non-delivery or item-mismatch claim, returns/refunds abuse, connector compromise, capability-scope abuse, third-party content injection and evidence/recourse.

Failure and recovery: stale/expired connection, partial failure, duplicate submissions/idempotency, denied permissions, missing approval, session interruption, supplier disappearance and settlement UNKNOWN.

Discovery-only checks: start from homepage/ordinary role landing screen and find a feature via visible navigation, universal intent, contextual opportunity or onboarding. No deep-link shortcut for initial discovery.
